rawRatingContainer.scale: 0 = unusable in observed scope; 5 = functional with substantial friction; 7 = good with clear limitations; 9 = excellent with minor friction; 10 = exceptional across assessed scope. Holistic judgment, not win/loss, score, or accuracy conversion. Unassessed features receive no inferred enjoyment credit.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, attractive short touch-assisted mission with clear progress, usable large main targets and successful sampled two-contact combat. Small distant targets, dense typography and unclear boss phase feedback constrain confidence.
reasons.controls: Manual MOVE with FIRE drag and separate scene turns visibly worked in both runs; target selection was forgiving. Large control anchors helped. Limited paused bursts cannot establish comfortable sustained thumb play or rearming. DASH/JUMP/AIM/tools untested.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, three-part Custodian and deck upload provided observable objective variety. Route assistance removed navigation friction but accounted for most travel and limited independent assessment of navigation/combat depth. Sustained challenge and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, reflective ground, cyan/orange contrast and station geometry gave a cohesive atmosphere; target-down and saved-memory overlays were clear. Audio was not assessed.
reasons.usability: Context-sensitive hold labels, objective changes, extraction map and explicit fresh start helped complete the sequence. Boss damage occurred across batches ending ARMORED, leaving phase-rule clarity uncertain.
reasons.readability: Main health/ammo, objective and terminal stats were legible. Patrol silhouettes, environmental labels and compact tactical text were noticeably small at landscape 844x390.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Entry guard and left perimeter patrol engaged with simultaneous native two-contact MOVE plus FIRE drag; target-down feedback observed. Left patrol visibly down, ammo 21 to 18.
coverage.map: Opened overview at return-to-deck; visibly closed.
coverage.boss: Three distinct coil taps with anchored FIRE; third depleted magazine and auto-reloaded, then coil III OFF.
coverage.misses_corrections: No observed missed patrol target tap; terminal 95% accuracy means some shots missed overall. Third coil remained 37% after empty magazine; fresh FIRE batch after auto-reload completed it. Shield visibly fell from 60 to 41 near boss, then 34 on deck.
coverage.unassessed: DASH, JUMP, AIM, tools, continuous held-fire rearming, unassisted route navigation

helpful: Contextual HOLD ROUTE / HOLD APPROACH labels
Coil OFF status and automatic reload
Map extraction selection and walking route distance
frustrating: ARMORED cue coexisted with successful coil damage; exact timing/mechanic unclear
attempts.protocol_deviation: Initial deployment used act tap at visible ENTER THE STORM geometry rather than requested #deploy selector; capture occurred in same batch, no bare click and no restart.

attempts.fresh_start: Visible START FRESH via act tap #play-again and capture; timer 00:00, ammo 30/180, health 100/shield 60. No checkpoint retry or third attempt.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Entry guard and right perimeter patrol engaged with simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag. TARGET DOWN / LAST SENTINEL DOWN observed; entry used 9 rounds and right patrol 3.
coverage.scene_turn: Separate scene swipe changed heading 051 to 023; fire drag also changed scene heading.
coverage.additional_combat: Left perimeter patrol tapped and fired from fresh observed screen, LAST SENTINEL DOWN. Three coil targets engaged separately. Two deck interceptors engaged separately.
coverage.misses_corrections: No visible failed target tap; terminal reports 100% accuracy, not an independent hit audit. Coil II still 47% when magazine emptied; after automatic reload a fresh FIRE contact completed it. No manual reload or continuous-contact rearming tested. Shield fell to 57 during boss route, recovered to 60, then 47 on deck; health remained 100 in inspected views.

helpful: Tap aim turned to distant patrol and target-down confirmed elimination
HOLD TO RECOVER progress at Mara was visible
Coil remaining percent exposed incomplete damage after empty magazine

frustrating: Coil open/armored messaging did not make damage timing fully understandable

attempts.what_tried: Repeated manual two-contact entry combat, sampled right patrol instead of first-run left patrol, turned scene, cleared left patrol later, used contextual route/recovery assistance, separately fired at each coil and visible deck enemies.

rawRatingContainer.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limitations, 9 excellent across assessed use, 10 exceptional. Scores are subjective observed mobile-emulation quality, not a mission-outcome grade or physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMOBILE: Coherent short mission with workable two-contact combat and useful navigation aids. Target readability and target-versus-cover ambiguity reduce confidence; continuous handheld comfort is unassessed. Both wins alone do not set this grade.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag produced visible guard/patrol kills in both attempts; scene swipe and threat turn worked. Tap aims and assisted shots contributed, preventing claims of unaided precision. Capture releases preclude held-burst rearming assessment.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, per-coil progress, and deck hold create understandable stage changes. The brief sampled combat is readable through feedback, but assisted travel dominates and long-term tension/enjoyment cannot be assessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, dark cyan/gold palette, industrial silhouettes, rifle feedback, and consistent title/result typography form a cohesive atmosphere. Audio was not assessed.
reasons.usability: Large persistent action controls, route/approach prompts, explicit map close, fresh restart and terminal stats help orientation. HOLD FACE COILS and cover-marker targeting needed interpretation.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, objectives and coil OFF states are clear. Distant targets, map legend, compact HUD copy and dark busy geometry make fine distinctions harder at 390px width.

uncertainties: Shot-level misses and assistance contribution not independently audited; game accuracy reported verbatim.
No audio, Safari, physical phones, hardware performance, continuous handheld comfort or continuous enjoyment assessment.
Recovered memory prose not opened; no enjoyment inferred from that unassessed content.
No causal benefit inferred from increased paused observation frequency.

coverage.patrol: Visible perimeter patrol, threat-cue turn then scene tap and simultaneous MOVE plus FIRE drag; SENTINEL DOWN displayed.
failures: Boss marker firing returned COVER; all coils remained 100%, ammo 17 to 06. Corrected by route approach and tapping visible coil heads.
Initial guard burst used 9 rounds; individual misses cannot be determined. Terminal accuracy was 80%.
